blockbuilder-explorer.visual_critic_note: Intentional dark theme with good typographic hierarchy (muted uppercase panel labels, clear header weight) and a coherent layout grid, but the Color Usage scatter panel is too dense to extract meaning at this size, and the force-graph labels overlap badly, undermining the two most complex panels.
blockbuilder-explorer.encoding_integrity_note: Strong encoding integrity: scaleSqrt used consistently for node and color-point sizes, bar chart has zero baseline with data-derived domain, no dual-axis issues, fixed hue/lightness domains are semantically appropriate — minor deduction for no key functions on timeline bar updates and hardcoded color-view axes that would jump on subset transformations.
blockbuilder-explorer.stress_test_note: RAF dirty-flag architecture correctly coalesces all redraws, pointer events eliminate mouse-touch fights, no transitions remove mid-flight snap risk, and no cross-view dispatch loops exist; however, the color brush handler synchronously rebuilds brushedBlocks by iterating all colorPoints on every mousemove before handing off to RAF, which can bottleneck on large datasets.
blockbuilder-explorer.cognitive_load_note: Four linked views (timeline brush, 60-node force network, color-dot scatter, block list) stay within working memory limits and each panel encodes density as a feature rather than noise, but the force network's center is congested enough that hub identity requires hovering rather than reading at a glance.
